scope: All 48 original interpreter blocks, inside six original provider processes, each exit 0. Tested RETURN code is distinct from availability/current-system/version queries. Exact raw byte hex, source effect, result and errorCode are preserved; no Unicode replacement, guessed availability, callback chronology, Rust result or constructor outcome is inserted.
